title: study.builder studies feed
description: One list of every study a reader can have from a study.builder site. Every entry is a study's configuration: settings, or a protocol a study can follow. An entry whose build is kept also names the file of its data. Version 1.

id.description: Names the entry for good. An id is never used again for another study.

kind.description: What the configuration is. settings: `settings` is what StudyBuilder.buildStudy takes. protocol: `protocol` is the file of a protocol a new study can follow.

about.description: A sentence or two for a reader.

line.description: The facts in a line, ready to show: Phase 2 · 120 participants · 12 sites · 7 months.

facts.description: What the line is made of. A fact that does not apply is left out or null.

study.description: The study's id in its own tables.

participants.description: Simulated for a study or settings; planned for a protocol.

snapshots.description: How many monthly snapshots the study keeps: 1 is the last only.

settings.description: For kind settings: the configuration itself.

protocol.description: For kind protocol: the protocol file, JSON in the format study.builder/protocol/1.

build.description: Present when the study's build is kept: its data, as gzipped JSON in the format study.builder/study/1. It opens with no R.

key.description: The key of the study's tables, as its manifest gives it.

url.description: Relative to the feed's own address.
